Based on the provided context, banks reported the following regarding investment banking revenue and fees in 2023 and 2024:

*   **Goldman Sachs (2023):** The firm generated record total financing revenues across its Global Banking & Markets businesses in 2023.
*   **Bank of America (Q1 2024):** Investment banking fees improved, though they were overcome by lower net interest income and higher provision expense, resulting in a 22% year-over-year decline in global banking earnings.
*   **JPMorgan Chase (Q3 2024):** In the Corporate & Investment Bank (CIB), investment banking fees were notably up year-on-year. Additionally, excluding prior year net investment securities losses, non-interest revenue ex-markets was up 10% on higher asset management and investment banking fees.
*   **Bank of America (Q4 2024):** The Global Banking business saw a rebound in investment banking fees for the full year 2024. Specifically in Q4, investment banking fees were $1.7 billion, growing 44% year-over-year, led by mergers and acquisitions, with strength also seen in debt and equity capital markets fees.
